steps.name: Click the start pre-qual manually button
Click Next to proceed to Mortgages & Liens
Close soft credit consent PDF tab(s)
Click Next to proceed to Offer Review
Acknowledge DTI above allowable limit (if required)
Click Next to proceed to Consents
Help desk widget — dismiss proactive bubble
Close confirmation and return to portal
A — borrower invite: open invitation email and extract the invite link
A3 — account setup from the invite link
Complete invited-borrower account setup
